title: Repair links and deliver an independent handover
goal: Transfer startup, link and search skills to an incident while preserving the source.
challenge: Repair the relative current link, make an independent readable handover copy with mode 0640, find the supplied stale reference and explain isolated startup versus persistent disk state. Preserve source bytes/mode and record facts separately from hypotheses. Use any valid scoped approach.

steps.command: w=$(mktemp -d "$HOME/local-handover.XXXXXX") && cd "$w" && pwd && here() { case "$w" in "$HOME"/local-handover.??????) ;; *) return 19;; esac; test "${w%/*}" = "$HOME" && test -d "$w" && test ! -L "$w" && test "$(realpath -e "$w")" = "$w" && test "$(stat -c %U:%a "$w")" = learner:700 && test "$(pwd -P)" = "$w"; }; fresh() { for f; do test ! -e "$f" && test ! -L "$f" || return 19; done; }; here
steps.explanation: Create a unique learner-owned guest workspace; stop on error and record its absolute path. Reopening boots the disk, not these shell variables. Never use the host terminal.
steps.expected: A new private directory; no pre-existing files are changed.

steps.command: here && fresh records links original.sha256 original.meta unsafe-copy.txt stale.txt && { mkdir records links; printf 'approved handover\n' > records/source.txt; chmod 0640 records/source.txt; sha256sum records/source.txt > original.sha256; stat -c '%a %h' records/source.txt > original.meta; ln -s ../missing.txt links/current; ln records/source.txt unsafe-copy.txt; printf 'obsolete path: missing.txt\n' > stale.txt; }
steps.explanation: Initial wrong link and incorrectly shared copy. The independent checks describe the original. Do not edit source or unsafe-copy contents.
steps.expected: Source, wrong relative link, shared inode and stale reference.

steps.command: here && { readlink links/current; stat -c "%d:%i %h %a %n" records/source.txt unsafe-copy.txt; find -P . -maxdepth 2 -type f -name "*.txt" -print; }
steps.explanation: Investigate before mutation. Challenge supplies only the first fixture step plus outcomes; these following commands are Learn suggestions, not a required transcript.
steps.expected: Evidence identifies the wrong target and shared copy.

steps.command: here && { test -L links/current && rm -- links/current && ln -s ../records/source.txt links/current && rm -- unsafe-copy.txt && cp -p records/source.txt handover.txt; }
steps.explanation: Remove only verified faulty names, then make an independent copy. Removing unsafe-copy restores the source link count to the initial reference before that link was created.
steps.expected: Correct link and independent copy; source preserved.

steps.command: here && { cat links/current handover.txt; sha256sum -c original.sha256; test "$(stat -c '%a %h' records/source.txt)" = "$(cat original.meta)"; stat -c "%d:%i %a %n" records/source.txt handover.txt; }
steps.explanation: Verify bytes, original metadata and independent inode. A successful ln/cp alone is not enough.
steps.expected: Correct contents, mode 640 and different copy inode.

steps.command: here && { printf '%s\n' 'FACT: current resolves to preserved source' 'FACT: handover has independent inode and mode 640' 'FACT: stale reference still retained for review' 'LIMIT: shell variables and jobs do not survive disk Resume' 'NEXT: review consumers before removing stale reference' > report.txt; cat report.txt; }
steps.explanation: Your report may use different words. Review factual accuracy against actual output; the app records self-review only, not a keyword score.
steps.expected: Concise factual handover and uncertainty, with original retained.

hints: Find which names share an inode before editing.
Repair only the wrong link; preserve the independent expectations.
Separate demonstrated facts from causal hypotheses.
review: I retained actual output and checked the required contents, metadata or identity, not just command success.
I can explain the stated limitations, demonstrate the incorrect case, preserve originals and clean up only my recorded workspace.
coverage: LPIC-1 v5.0 partial 104.6 /104.7 /105.1 reinforcement. Self-reviewed and unscored: the application does not inspect guest results. No full-objective or exam-readiness claim.
